<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'RbN' and n['pixels']==16:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b)
            if r0<50: out[n['color']]=(min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return out
print('before:',blocks(current_frame))
action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT x1:',blocks(current_frame))
print('result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
